subject.title: Feature request: Docker-based self-hosting without a Cloudflare dependency

question: Should ClawRouter support a non-Cloudflare production runtime as a first-class deployment target?
rationale: The request changes the supported runtime, persistence, identity, migration, and operational model; source inspection cannot determine whether maintainers want to own that permanent compatibility surface.

options.title: Sponsor portability RFC
options.body: Define backend contracts and acceptance tests before selecting Docker storage, queue, and identity implementations.

options.title: Keep Cloudflare-only
options.body: Document Cloudflare Workers as the sole supported production runtime and avoid a second operational architecture.

recommendation.title: Sponsor portability RFC
recommendation.body: Define backend contracts and acceptance tests before selecting Docker storage, queue, and identity implementations.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current gateway and deployment architecture and are best positioned to judge whether its Cloudflare services should become portable interfaces.
